messages:
alex-m: quick follow-up from the postmortem thread — this outage (auth provider token service) was the third auth-related regression in ~6 months and it brought down model-registry writes and token refreshes briefly. need to lock owners and timelines for the mitigation items we sketched. starting list below, please ack and volunteer or delegate.

priya-s: +1. timeline notes: outage was at 03:14 UTC, service recovered by 03:46. root cause: provider-side token refresh throttling under maintenance, we hit ~15% token error rate which cascaded to registry write failures. recurring pattern: maintenance windows + spike in bulk deploys.

oncall-jen: adding a quick tl;dr from oncall: fallback worked for read traffic but write path failed and caused backlog + retries. we had to manually flip to retry-suppress mode to avoid DB pressure.

marc-r: suggestion: add a short-circuit local-cache for registry writes during auth provider degradation and queue async apply. also add exponential backoff jitter at SDK-level. small sample change for SDK:

```
// pseudocode
if (auth_error && cache.has_recent_token()) {
  use_cached_token_for_read_only(); // allow reads
  enqueue_write_for_background_apply();
} else {
  propagate_error();
}
```

ops-bot: created INF-3421 - "auth-fallbacks: local-cache + failover plan" assigned to marc-r, priya-s. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421

alex-m: proposed action items (please reply with owner + ETA):
- multi-auth-provider failover (primary + secondary token issuer + health check) -> owner: ? -> ETA: 3w
- local model-registry write-queue + async apply (best-effort) -> owner: marc-r -> ETA: 2w
- SDK retry/backoff + read-only cached-token behavior -> owner: marc-r -> ETA: 1w
- alerting: new SLO-based alert when token error rate > 5% for 5m -> owner: priya-s -> ETA: 3d
- runbook update & canary for maintenance windows (avoid bulk deploys during provider maintenance) -> owner: oncall-jen -> ETA: EOW
- legal/contract: escalate SLA + scheduled maintenance visibility with provider -> owner: emma-cs -> ETA: 2w

priya-s: I'll take the alerting + run the health-check probe for secondary provider. ETA 3d. will add test harness to simulate token-throttle so we can validate failover.

marc-r: OK I'll split SDK work + queue. SDK retry PR will land tomorrow, queue prototype in 1 week, full rollout in 2 weeks. I'll link PRs into INF-3421.

emma-cs: pinged vendor account team, asked for maintenance calendar and a formal RCA for the token service. starting escalation now, will share reply in this thread. ETA 2w for contract/visibility outcomes.

oncall-jen: I'll own the runbook edits and deploy gating for maintenance windows. will add quick checklist and a pre-maintenance traffic cap in deployment pipeline. ETA Friday COB.

alex-m: great — two extra asks: 1) we should add a recurring review (monthly) to check auth provider incidents and verify mitigations are trending down. owner: priya-s? 2) capture a small incident playbook snippet that PMs and SREs can use for customer comms. owner: emma-cs?

priya-s: I can own the monthly review. adding a lightweight dashboard: token-error-rate, registry-write-fail-rate, throttled-requests. will create INF-3422 for dashboard work.

emma-cs: I'll draft the customer-facing playbook snippet and share for PR by Tue.

ops-bot: INF-3421 updated: owners set [marc-r, priya-s], subtasks created: INF-3421-1 (SDK retry), INF-3421-2 (queue), INF-3421-3 (alerts).

alex-m: ok, last bit — recurrence analysis: this is incident #3 in 6mo that tracks back to provider maintenance windows. recommend we prioritize multi-provider token failover + contractual maintenance visibility as higher priority than the other mitigations. if no objections, I'll escalate priority on INF-3421 and ask PMs to re-scope roadmap.

marc-r: agree on priority. I'll get a draft failover plan (health-check + token provider switch) and share in INF-3421 by EOW.

priya-s: acked. no objections.

oncall-jen: ack. will include a gate in runbook to prevent large deploys during provider-scheduled maintenance windows.

emma-cs: ack. I have the vendor contact on it.

alex-m: thanks all — marking this thread as follow-up tracker. will do a quick sync on Mon 10:00am to confirm blockers. if anyone needs to reassign, update INF-3421 or ping here. :thumbsup:
